question: In the spent FCC catalyst recovery route, what climate-change impact did the leaching-residue-valorization stage have before product-substitution credits?
expect: 1,940.11 kg CO2-eq per t (the wet-recovery stage: 1,536.56) (abstract)
trap: the wet-recovery stage's 1,536.56 or the net −2,257.14
rendered: According to the document, the climate-change impact of the leaching-residue-valorization stage before product-substitution credits was not directly stated. However, it is mentioned that the climate-change impact of the leaching-residue-valorization stage was 1,940.11 kg CO2-eq per t of spent FCC catalyst after system expansion, and all 16 main impact categories showed net environmental benefits under the adopted substitution assumptions.
